template:
You parse a plain-text resume into a structured profile. Extract only what is literally present — never invent or normalise in missing fields.

Resume text: {{resumeText}}

Return valid JSON with exactly these keys:
- name (string or null)
- email (string or null)
- phone (string or null)
- skills (array of strings)
- experiences (array of {title, company, duration, highlights: [string]})
- education (array of {degree, institution, year})
- certifications (array of strings)
- summary (one sentence, or null)
